step1_catalog_metrics.command: docker exec -i ssvm-database psql -U postgres -d <db> -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public') AS total_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy) AS total_policies, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true) AS rls_forced_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tableowner != 'postgres') AS non_postgres_owned_tables;"
